data.body: [P2] Preserve cause chains in the SDK's log formatters. Making `cause` non-enumerable also changes `context.logger.error(err)`: `jsonErrorReplacer` in `utils/logger/default-logger.ts` copies errors with `Object.assign`, and `safeStringify` uses object spread. Logging `new StepError("Step failed", new Error("card declined"))` therefore loses the inner message and stack that were previously emitted. Explicitly preserve `cause` in both error-formatting paths and add regression coverage for logging a durable error with a nested cause.
